label: Has eminent holy site
summary: Whether the given holy site is one of the faith's eminent holy sites.
details: It is checked on a faith. The value is a holy site. Vanilla writes `prev` (the previous scope in the chain) or a saved scope such as `scope:holy_site`.

label: Has holy site
summary: Whether the given holy site is a holy site of the faith, eminent or not.
details: It is checked on a faith. The value is a holy site. Unlike the eminent check, any holy site of the faith counts.

label: Faith is involved
summary: Whether the given faith is involved in the struggle.
details: It is checked on a struggle, and the value is a faith, for example `faith:baltic_pagan` or a character's faith such as `root.faith`.

label: Is favorite child
summary: Whether the character is the favorite child of their liege.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`. The game's text says only "their liege's favorite child" and the input shows no vanilla use.

label: Is female
summary: Whether the character is female.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`. Vanilla uses it very often, mostly as `yes`.

label: Is figurehead title
summary: Whether the title counts as a figurehead title.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`, checked on a title. The game does not explain what makes a title a figurehead title, and vanilla does not use it in the input.

label: Is filled
summary: Whether the agent slot has someone in it.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`, checked on an agent slot. Vanilla mostly checks for `no`, an empty slot.

label: Follows head challenger
summary: Whether the character follows a challenger to the religious head.
details: A character follows a challenger if they are one, sponsor one, are a vassal of one or of their sponsor, or are a religious subordinate of one or of their sponsor. Written as `yes` or `no`.

label: Is forbidden from scheme
summary: Whether the character is forbidden from the given scheme.
details: The value is a scheme. The game does not say more, and vanilla does not use it in the input.

label: Is forced into faction
summary: Whether the character is forced to be part of a faction.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`. Vanilla uses it only as `no`.

label: Is forced into scheme
summary: Whether the character is forced into the given scheme.
details: The value is a scheme. Vanilla does not use it in the input.

label: Is forced winner
summary: Whether this side of a combat has been set as the forced winner.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`, checked on a combat side. The forced winner is set with `forced_winner = yes`.

label: Is foreign court guest
summary: Whether the character is a guest at another ruler's court.
details: Unlike a pool guest, this character has a liege. Written as `yes` or `no`.

label: Foreign guest of
summary: Whether the character is a guest from another court, visiting the given character's court.
details: Unlike `is_pool_guest_of`, this character has a liege. The value is the host character, often `root` or a saved scope.

label: Is any guest
summary: Whether the character is a guest, either a pool guest or a guest from a foreign court.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`. It covers both `is_pool_guest` and `is_foreign_court_guest`.

label: Any guest of
summary: Whether the character is a guest at the given character's court, as a pool guest or a foreign court guest.
details: It covers both `is_pool_guest_of` and `is_foreign_court_guest_of`. The game's text does not mention the target, but its usage and vanilla pass a host character, often `root`.

label: Made in ruler designer
summary: Whether the character was created in the ruler designer.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`.

label: Frontend character selected
summary: Whether the specified front-end character is selected.
details: An interface trigger that works only in specific places. It can also be written as `yes` or `no`. The game documents nothing more about what a front-end character is, and vanilla does not use it in the input.

label: Game view is open
summary: Whether the named in-game window or view is open.
details: An interface trigger that works only in specific places. Vanilla writes the view's name, for example `title_view_window`, `activity_planner`, `my_realm` or `cardinals_window`.

label: Gamestate tutorial active
summary: Whether the gamestate tutorial is active.
details: An interface trigger that works only in specific places. Written as `yes` or `no`. The game points to `save_progress_in_gamestate` in the tutorial lesson chain documentation. Vanilla uses it only as `no`.

label: Is grandchild of
summary: Whether the character is a grandchild of the given character.
details: The value is the possible grandparent, often `root` or a saved scope.

label: Is grandparent of
summary: Whether the character is a grandparent of the given character.
details: The value is the possible grandchild, often `root` or a saved scope.

label: Is great-grandchild of
summary: Whether the character is a great-grandchild of the given character.
details: The value is the possible great-grandparent, often `root` or a saved scope.

label: Is great-grandparent of
summary: Whether the character is a great-grandparent of the given character.
details: The value is the possible great-grandchild, often `root` or a saved scope.

label: Is head of faith title
summary: Whether the title is the head of faith title of a faith.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`, checked on a title.

label: Is heir of
summary: Whether the character is an heir of the given character.
details: The game's text ends with an unfinished "[placeholder]" where it should say what they are heir to, so the exact meaning is not documented. Vanilla passes a character, often `root`.

label: Is hired regiment
summary: Whether a men-at-arms regiment was hired from a mercenary company or a holy order.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`, checked on a regiment.

label: Is holy order
summary: Whether the title is a holy order.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`, checked on a title.

label: Is holy relic
summary: Whether the artifact is potentially a holy relic for a faith.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`. The game's text says "potentially" and names no faith. To check against one faith use `is_holy_relic_for`.

label: Is holy relic for faith
summary: Whether the artifact is a holy relic for the given faith.
details: The value is a faith, for example a character's faith such as `root.faith` or a saved scope.

label: Is holy site
summary: Whether the barony is a holy site of any faith.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`. To ask about one faith use `is_holy_site_of`.

label: Holy site controlled by
summary: Whether the given character controls a holy site of the checked title or object.
details: The game's text says "the scoped object"; the key is listed for titles. The value is a character, often `root`.

label: Is holy site of faith
summary: Whether the barony is a holy site of the given faith.
details: The value is a faith, for example a character's faith such as `root.faith` or a saved scope.

label: Holy site type
summary: Whether the holy site is of the given holy site type.
details: The value is the type's name, for example `holy_site_rome` in the game's text. Vanilla's one use in the input writes `mecca`.

label: Is hostage
summary: Whether the character is a hostage.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`.

label: Hostage from
summary: Whether the character is a hostage whose original liege is the given character.
details: The value is the original liege. To check the warden instead use `is_hostage_of`.

label: Hostage of
summary: Whether the character is a hostage held by the given character as their warden.
details: The value is the warden, often `root` or a saved scope. To check the original liege instead use `is_hostage_from`.

label: Is hostage warden
summary: Whether the character is a warden who holds hostages.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`. Vanilla uses it only as `yes`.

label: Is hostile scheme
summary: Whether the scheme is a hostile scheme.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`, checked on a scheme.

label: Is house based
summary: Whether the confederation is based on houses, as a bloc.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`, checked on a confederation. Vanilla uses it only as `no`.
